constraints.name: blacklists_club_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES clubs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: blacklists_scope_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((club_id IS NOT NULL) OR (union_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: blacklists_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_blacklists_club_id_fk ON public.blacklists USING btree (club_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX blacklists_pkey ON public.blacklists USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_blacklists_club ON public.blacklists USING btree (club_id) WHERE (club_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_blacklists_user ON public.blacklists USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_blacklists_club_user_permanent ON public.blacklists USING btree (club_id, user_id) WHERE ((club_id IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uniq_blacklists_union_user_permanent ON public.blacklists USING btree (union_id, user_id) WHERE ((union_id IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL))
CREATE INDEX idx_blacklists_banned_by ON public.blacklists USING btree (banned_by)
